planets.name: HD 50554 b
planets.description: Planet of HD 50554 found by radial velocity, with a 1240-day year, found in 2002.

text.card: HD 50554 b was found in 2002 by Lick Observatory by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 50554. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Xiao et al. 2023's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.

quotes.title: HD 50554 b
quotes.card: HD 50554 b is a Jupiter-sized exoplanet with a minimum mass 4.4 times that of Jupiter.
quotes.introduction: The planet was announced in 2001 by the European Southern Observatory and formally published in 2002 using observations from the Lick and Keck telescopes.
